staged_result_title.trigger: source title exceeds the chosen result type limit; Node 100 or Bit 200
staged_result_title.within_limit: skip this step and retain the exact source title
staged_result_title.initial_draft: empty; never a clipped, truncated, or normalized source copy

copy.heading: Name this {Node|Bit}
copy.explanation: The source is {count} characters. A {Node|Bit} title can be up to {limit}. The source won’t change.
copy.label: Result title

staged_result_title.validation: accept draft input without silent clipping or source mutation; Continue remains unavailable until canonical non-empty and selected-type length validation passes
staged_result_title.focus: entry focuses Result title; valid Continue focuses the next placement-step heading
staged_result_title.source_truth: the source remains unchanged and remains the Undo/restoration truth

copy.heading: Choose a result type
copy.node_reason: Node titles can be up to 100 characters. This source has {count}.
copy.bit_reason: Bit titles can be up to 200 characters. This source has {count}.

length_matrix.101-200: Node unavailable with its reason; Bit available
length_matrix.201-1000: Node and Bit unavailable with per-type reasons and the neither-available instruction

direct_type_limit.accessibility: entry focuses the heading; unavailable rows remain visible with native unavailable semantics and associated non-hover reasons; tab order reaches only available types and Cancel
direct_type_limit.editor_boundary: no direct Result Title input, truncation, or alternate type selection

cancel_and_invalidation.cancel_or_escape: write nothing, discard only the uncommitted draft, and return to the surviving staged candidate or Breakdown grip, otherwise the owning section heading
cancel_and_invalidation.source_candidate_target_or_path_change: close the flow, discard the draft, write nothing, announce the named authoritative change once, and use the same safe focus fallback
cancel_and_invalidation.navigation: no internal intent is queued or replayed; only a dirty staged Result Title draft may use the native browser-unload guard

motion.ordinary: step swap, validation-state change, close, and focus handoff are immediate and static
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, spinner, shimmer, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, focus, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: compact technical form card and ruled eligibility rows with canonical error, action, and focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: pinned paper form slip and library-index type rows inside the target column
theme_mapping.neumorphism: raised compact step with inset field, counter, reason trough, and existing shadow variables
theme_mapping.claymorphism: sculpted compact form plate and tactile type rows with static availability shape
theme_mapping.origami: folded label sheet, seam-bound field/error, and cut-paper rows with no animated fold
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven prompt, static count/error record, and [N]/[B] rows with textual unavailable reasons
theme_mapping.retro-mac: in-pane compact system form with hard field/buttons and disabled rows; no new window or dialog
theme_mapping.graphite: restrained registry form and strengthened-rule rows with monochrome reason and precise focus outline

implementation_boundary.excludes: product implementation in Task 116, DP-VQ08 reliability changes, DP-VQ10 Newly/Undo appearance, command/repository changes, prototype fallback, and theme-ID logic
